newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN INTERVENTION BOARD DETAILS EU SUGAR SALE.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN INTERVENTION BOARD DETAILS EU SUGAR SALE.

text.p: A total 16,000 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 39.857 European currency units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at the European Union tender, the German Intervention Board BLE said.
The entire 16,000 tonnes went to traders in France.
This week's award was the second in the 1997/98 series and brought the cumulative total for 1997/98 to 44,000.
This week's result compares with the 33,000 tonnes awarded on Aug 14, 1996, when the cumulative tonnage totalled 56,000 tonnes.
Last week, the EU awarded 28,000 tonnes of white sugar at a maximum rebate of 39.437 Ecus per 100 kilos.
